authority: User approved Phase 3 on 2026-10-10: 48 new loss-comparison sends only.
factor: Explicit source-grounded missing_obligation replaces diagnostic detail as the loss target; diagnostic detail and target purpose remain supporting evidence. Context, member collections, schema and controls unchanged. This tests the combined shared contract/guidance; not independent effects of each wording change.

limits.usage_stop_semantics: Check actual cumulative usage after every completed exchange; at or above threshold send no further trial. A single in-flight completion may cross the threshold. This is an experiment spending stop, not a runtime reservation or provider token ceiling. No dollar cap is asserted.

quality_gate.gate_failure: No semantic promotion or Phase 4 invocation. Preserve findings; no automatic retries or additional calls.

cases.missing_obligation: When started, the application must display Hello, World!.
When an eligible borrower requests renewal of a loan with no reservation, the service must extend its due date by seven days.
When the reservoir falls below the minimum, the pump must stop and remain stopped until the level recovers.
After the chamber door closes, the fan may restart only when the operator confirms readiness.
Parcel release requires both recipient identity verification and payment confirmation.
After an appointment is cancelled, the service must notify the patient.
During power loss, the cabinet must keep medicine cold for eight hours, and an alarm must sound if backup cooling fails.
Ending a parking session requires settled payment; failed payment must leave the session active.

assessment.review: Manual semantic assessment, unblinded; no model judge. Independent pre-call label review by separate code-review agent.
